context.why: Story 1 is accepted. fairdm/core/editing.py holds RecordEditingPage (the access rule: verdict, may_be_used_by, dispatch, get_object, record_name), EditDetails, EditDescriptions and manage_menu, registered on Project, Dataset, Sample and Measurement with menu=False and imported at the foot of fairdm/core/measurement/plugins.py. <c-actions.manage> draws the menu on all four overviews. tests/test_core/test_editing.py holds TestRegistration, TestAccess, TestManageMenu, TestEditDetails, TestEditDescriptions and TestOverviewPrompts with their fixtures. This story adds the key dates page and the identifiers page on all four record types, and takes the date and identifier rows off the details page of a project and a dataset. It removes the sample's old KeyDates page and its generic base.
prior_decisions: decisions.md planning decisions D8 to D13, written in story 1: read them, they describe the module as it stands (import location, stacked rows until this story, the helper reset, the menu's slot).

The pages are rows alone: FairDMUpdateView with fields = () so django-mvp's InlinesMixin.is_rows_only() is true (.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/mvp/views/inline.py). Check how the old dataset update template drew rows as a table (git show 6053856e:fairdm/core/dataset/templates/dataset/plugins/update.html) and use django-mvp's tabular row layout for both pages if it is available without a custom template; rows of a type and a value read best as a table.

Add SampleDateInline, SampleIdentifierInline, MeasurementDateInline and MeasurementIdentifierInline to fairdm/core/related_records.py beside the project and dataset ones. ProjectDatesInline and DatasetDatesInline are already there and carry the end-before-start rule. No ordering rule applies to samples or measurements.

The sample menu passes its key dates item through the component's slot today (fairdm/core/sample/templates/sample/sample_overview.html). Remove that item when manage_menu lists the shared page, and leave the keywords item in the slot for story 4. Leave the project and dataset delete items in the slot for story 3.
manage_menu order is fixed: edit details, descriptions, keywords, key dates, identifiers, delete. Keywords and delete are not registered yet.
The record's portal ID is its uuid field, never a row among its identifiers (FR-029). The test asserts no row carries it and that a POST cannot change record.uuid.

Where a record's vocabulary offers no date types or no identifier types, the page says there is nothing to record and offers nothing to save (spec Edge Cases). Build this only if it is reachable without patching library internals; otherwise say so in concerns.
The readiness checklists of the project and dataset overviews have items for dates and for a DOI that pointed at the details page; they now carry the key dates and identifiers addresses.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given the test classes tasks.md T004 lists, when they are run before T005, then they fail because the two pages do not exist and the details page still carries the rows.

Given a project, a dataset, a demo sample type and a demo measurement type, when someone at each level requests and submits the key dates and identifiers pages, then every outcome in tasks.md T004 holds, the details page of a project and a dataset carries no rows, and the sample's old key dates page is gone.
Given the documentation, when it is read, then record-editing-pages.md covers the two pages and the user guide says where a project's and a dataset's dates and identifiers are edited.
